name: Ritz Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes
positioning: Resort on more than 500 acres near International Drive in Orlando, with a Greg Norman-designed golf course, a spa and a waterpark; official name The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes
best_for: Golfers who want a championship-hosting course on site
Families wanting a waterpark and a kids' program
Guests who want outdoor activities such as eco-tours and falconry

facts.text: The resort sits on more than 500 acres of natural landscapes, lakes and a working farm.
The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club hosts the PNC Championship.
The golf course is certified as an Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary.
The spa has an outdoor lap pool and a spa café called Vitale.
Knife & Spoon is the resort's signature steakhouse, led by Chef John Tesar.
Highball & Harvest serves modern Southern food and cocktails.
The resort's restaurants source produce, herbs and other ingredients from its garden, apiaries and chicken coops.
The resort is near International Drive.
Club Lounge guests receive complimentary food and beverage presentations five times a day.
Ritz Kids entertains young guests with storytelling, animal care lessons, arts and crafts and physical activities.

highlights.text: The resort has an 18-hole golf course designed by two-time British Open champion Greg Norman.
Guests can take a guided Shingle Creek eco-tour by kayak or canoe toward the headwaters of the Everglades.
Signature spa therapies use honey from the resort's resident bees, citrus from local orchards and other homegrown ingredients.
The Grande Lakes Waterpark has waterslides, a lazy river, lagoons and a VIP firepit lounge.
The Space Exploration Experience flies guests by private helicopter to NASA's Kennedy Space Center for a VIP guided tour.

considerations.text: Club Lounge access requires a Club booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
WhataHotel notes the large resort property may require walking or shuttle transport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
